name: tts-cpp
description: Text-to-speech inference in pure C++/ggml. Ships Resemble Chatterbox (Turbo + Multilingual variants) and Supertonic engines under a unified Engine API. Sourced from tetherto/qvac-ext-lib-whisper.cpp's tts-cpp/ subfolder. This pin (master HEAD d16d7853, PR #81 merged, QVAC-18632) adds per-op GPU->CPU fallback for the T3 (Chatterbox Turbo/MTL) engine via a new shared sched_dispatch helper: a graph_fully_supported() walk keeps the direct gallocr path byte-for-byte unchanged when the primary backend supports every op, and a lazily-created ggml_backend_sched fallback ([primary, CPU-last]) with a pre-sched guard converts the scheduler's uncatchable GGML_ABORT on a pre-allocated KV-cache tensor into a graceful, catchable engine error instead of a process abort. On-device (Adreno 740, Vulkan, T3 on GPU) master SIGSEGVs at load (quantize_q8_1_x4 pipeline-compile failure); this pin surfaces a clean catchable error instead. S3Gen and Supertonic are folded onto the same shared helper and a Supertonic sched graph-reuse corruption bug is fixed. Two commits ahead of the 1d9ca83 pin (PR #79, QVAC-19557, Chatterbox Samsung S25 / Adreno GPU-load crash fix: the OpenCL Q4_0/Q8_0 SOA set_tensor path read the whole ggml_nbytes and ignored the (offset,size) window, so T3-MTL stacked-wqkv and gguf_stream chunked uploads over-read and SIGSEGV on Adreno at load; both now upload quantized weights whole) -- the intervening commit is an unrelated CI security-baseline rollout (#75) that does not touch tts-cpp. Prior pin (master HEAD 6c64f18, PR #78) implements the LavaSR denoiser forward -- the UL-UNAS GRU U-Net (ERB-band feature encoder, grouped depthwise-separable conv encoder/decoder, DPGRNN dual-path bottleneck, causal time-frequency attention) that denoises speech before the Vocos enhancer bandwidth-extends it -- completing the tts_cpp::lavasr::Denoiser API scaffolded in PR #76: Denoiser::load() + denoise() now run the CPU/GGML forward (f32 + f16 GGUF loader, onnxruntime spec- and full-pipeline-parity tests, ONNX->GGUF converter with topology + source-md5 provenance checks). Backward compatible: with no denoiser config the output is byte-identical to the prior pin. Exactly one commit ahead of 9ea1a5e (PR #77, Chatterbox MTL Chinese (zh) support: zh added to mtl_tokenizer::supported_languages() so Chinese is accepted instead of rejected at load, flowing through the existing Cangjie hanzi->code preprocessing; encode() throws a clear error if zh is enabled without a Cangjie5_TC TSV (cangjie_tsv_path / CHATTERBOX_CANGJIE_TSV)), itself one commit ahead of d149258 (PR #71, chatterbox-mtl Metal q8 KV-on-GPU real fix), one ahead of 032cee10 (PR #76, LavaSR denoiser scaffold; now activated by this pin). Layered on ce9ee96f (PR #69, output-frequency selection; master also took the whisper.cpp v1.9.1 upstream sync PR #73 and a parakeet-cpp ggml_backend_sched change PR #74 in between), 28f37eae (PR #72, MeCab support for Chatterbox MTL Japanese), 4c8767a2 (PR #68, LavaSR enhancer), 586268bf (PR #67, ARM Mali Vulkan Chatterbox), 46921668 (PR #65, S3TokenizerV2 host-mirror elimination), 1cc2d383 (chunk-streaming CFM-step floor), a679c7e7 (streamed GGUF loads + selectable KV-cache dtype), and the b95ad447 base (EOS robustness PR #53 + Supertonic Android GPU PR #54). Consumes the ggml-speech and mecab ports.
